newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares close at new high, Ericsson gains.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares close at new high, Ericsson gains.

text.p: Swedish share prices closed at a record high on Wednesday for the second consecutive day, boosted by a jump in telecoms group Ericsson and a higher opening in New York in afternoon trade.
The Stockholm bourse general index rose 0.65 pct to 2,715.54 in trade totalling 5.11 billion crowns.
The market focus was on Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan's Congressional testimony at 1900 GMT.
A strong dollar and cheerful sentiment about the telecommunications sector boosted Ericsson and the share closed up 5.5 crowns at 252.5.
"A cocktail with many ingredients is lifting Ericsson. Among these is a rumour that it's high time high-tech shares in the U.S. turn upwards," one broker said.
Insurance company Skandia closed three crowns down at 225 crowns after posting a lower-than-expected pre-tax profit for 1996.
The stronger dollar boosted engineering groups Atlas Copco, which rose 8.5 crowns to 183 and SKF which closed up four crowns at 193.
It also underpinned the forestry sector. SCA rose two crowns to 170 and Modo rose 6.5 crowns to 249.5.
